project.name: Inspecto — demo auth (offline demo builds only, NEVER an edition)
project.description: DEMO-AUTH-1: a Demo User sign-in for an offline demo build with no IAM. Contributes a TokenRelay (behind /auth/exchange) and an Authenticator; Demo Users live in each Space's config/demo-users.toon and resolve to capabilities through that Space's role table, exactly as OIDC groups do. It proves nothing about identity, so it refuses to load unless the control plane is bound to loopback, and no edition bundles it: tools/bundle-modules.mjs does not list it, and only `package.ps1 -DemoAuth` stages it. Built in the default reactor so its tests always run. No third-party dependency.
